response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced web/full-stack and systems engineer with strong C/C++ background from years ago, but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements: no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, and no demonstrated background in embedded networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP). His recent career trajectory is firmly in web/cloud/TypeScript development, not embedded firmware security.
strengths: Strong, broad software engineering background spanning 15+ years including C/C++ work
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and low-level languages (DLang, C++, async I/O)
Track record of leadership, mentoring, and independent ownership (staff/senior roles, workshops, open source founder)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel source-code investigation or modification experience
No background in embedded networking, LAN switches, or required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded networking/security experience
